notes: 1912 corner flats at Filbert, light khaki painted wood siding with cream trim over a red-brown brick garage storey. Three round (bowed) bays across the Hyde front from the first upper storey to the roof, deep dentilled cornice, a small fire escape between the north and middle bays. Ground: a white garage door at the north end, a recessed columned entry left of centre, a wide white double garage door right of centre. The Filbert flank (edge 1) gets windows over the brick base. The brick base read salmon-pink against a red-brown street brick and the bay caps hid the cornice; brick tinted darker red-brown, bays slightly shallower, cornice projects further. Buff brick street storey (brick-buff kit); paler olive-khaki cream siding; each of the three round bays is a deeper two-segment swell carrying a centre sash and two curved side sashes per storey; the fire escape platforms now sit on the front of the centre bay; ground: two white panelled sectional garage doors (panel grid on a white leaf, not roll-ups) with a recessed entry between them flanked by two cream column-width piers. Heavy bellcast rings and an ornate cornice beyond the bay plates and the stepped cornice have no key; the third bay storey needs a storey-count change (data: 3). A 3.4 m street storey (floorsM) and 4.0 m bay storeys, the walls stopping at 12.2 m (wallTopM) under the LiDAR allowance; smoother curved bays (four facets a quarter) a little shallower with plates at each floor, olive-khaki siding and cream trim; heavier cornice projecting past the bay caps; fire escape removed; ground: one wide white panelled garage door, then a deep recessed entry reached by a pale stone stoop of eight flat step bands, a low red-brown brick plinth under a cream street-storey wall. Four-facet quarters left no room for side sashes, so the bays go back to two-segment curves (three sashes a storey) at a deeper projection. Viewer-left to right the ground is a narrow white garage, a recessed entry porch between round columns, then a wide white garage. Applied: four storeys via storeysSeen (3.4 m base + three 3.12 m bay storeys, the trees hide the lower bays), tan buff brick base to 3.4 m with the red plinth and cream zone removed, cream-khaki wall d6cca6. Fire escape skipped: the gap between swell bays is under 0.8 m. Round columns/porch arch have no key. Red-brown brick base 9a6848, olive-tan trim b0a070, garage doors changed from a glazed lattice to cream sectional panels with one row of small dark lites. Fire escape and porch column still skipped (gap between bays < 0.8 m; no column key). Applied: olive-khaki wall b9ae82 with cream trim, hyB round bays with curved belt cornices, modillion/dentil cornice. SKIPPED: arched stair entry on the right and cream stucco base (those belong to the cream neighbour; target ground is narrow garage / covered porch / wide garage over brick); fire escape (gap between bays too small). Clapboard fix (2026-10-02): painted siding moved from the stained-timber wood-siding base to painted-clapboard so the tint renders as paint, not olive. Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k).
